question: Where will the National Coral Reef Research Institute (NCRRI) be established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chidiyatapu, South Andaman.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• The Government of India will establish the **National Coral Reef Research Institute (NCRRI)** at **Chidiyatapu in South Andaman**, with a total investment of ₹120 crore.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• NCRRI will act as the **nodal and monitoring agency** for all coral reef research across India.
 
• The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change is setting up this **first-of-its-kind advanced coral research and conservation centre.**
 
• The institute aims to strengthen work on coral reef **research, management, coastal protection** and conservation.
 
• Coral reefs play a crucial role in **natural coastal protection**, mitigating wave impact and reducing loss of life and property in coastal areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Investment & Structure**__

 __
 
• The NCRRI will be set up at a cost of **₹120 crore**.
 
• It will serve as an advanced centre for **research, conservation, and management** of coral ecosystems.
 
 
 
• **Coral Reefs & Significance**__
 __
 
• Coral reefs act as **natural barriers** against storms and reduce the impact of waves on shorelines.
 
• They protect coastal communities by preventing erosion, property loss, and damage from extreme weather.
 
 
 
• **Biodiversity in Andaman & Nicobar Islands**__
 __
 
• The islands are one of India’s **four biodiversity hotspots**.
 
• Home to rich indigenous and migratory species.
 
• Climate change impacts—like **sea-level rise** and increasing temperatures—pose threats to coral and marine habitats.
 
 
 
• **Other Developments**__
 
 
• A **QR code–based system** will be introduced at ZSI Museum, allowing digital access to species information.
 
• The government is supporting initiatives to **interlink agriculture with island biodiversity**.
 
• Personnel from agencies such as the **Indian Coast Guard, Indian Army, INS Jarawa**, and A&N Police participated in a workshop on coastal and marine biodiversity.
